output.explanation: The signed 2026 Renewal Order Form, which took effect 2026-04-01 and runs through 2027-03-31, sets a 10% discount on the USD 1,920 per-seat price. The 15% discount appears only in the unsigned Amendment No. 2 draft, which states it has no binding force, so it does not apply.
